Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 160. Category: equipment. .

Laser Weapons are made to fight in such a way to
bypass through the normal resistances, making it
perfect to fight against those who carry an innnate
resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.
All laser weapons counts as martial weapons for the
purposes of proficiency and Weapon Techniques.
